issues.where: the dark reflective oval in the middle of the lake
issues.what: a hard-edged blue disc of mirror reflection with concentric rings sits on an opaque flat orange surface; two water materials meet on a clean outline with a cyan rim, reading as a composited patch rather than one body of water
issues.fix: use one water shader across the lake and let reflectivity and colour change gradually with depth and angle; remove the stamped ripple rings

issues.where: the boulders in the right and left foreground
issues.what: large rocks are low-poly with visible facets and a stretched grey texture smeared across the faces, reading as plastic or clay at close range
issues.fix: use higher-density geometry with displacement and a texture mapped at the right scale, plus moss, staining and varied albedo

issues.where: the animals standing in the shallows (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the animals are flat brown silhouettes with no shading or detail, no splash or ripples around the legs, and only a faint dark smudge for shadow; they look like cut-outs pasted on the water
issues.fix: render them with lighting that matches the low warm sun, add ripples, wet darkening on the legs, and correct reflections

issues.where: the orange lake surface, left (x 0 to 17%, y 58 to 75%)
issues.what: the water is a smooth airbrushed orange with flat pale blobs floating on it; there is no depth, ripple detail or clear reflection, and the blobs read as flat cards
issues.fix: add surface micro-ripples, a fresnel reflection of the sky and cliffs, and give the pale patches thickness, edges and a wet margin if they are salt or crust

issues.where: the top of the crop where the cliff reflection meets the orange water
issues.what: the cliff reflection ends in vertical smeared streaks and a hard horizontal edge
issues.fix: blend the reflection boundary and remove the stretched streaking

issues.where: the far water band (x 83 to 100%, y 25 to 42%) and set-A-05.png at the same region
issues.what: the water is made of horizontal stretched streaks with smeared texture, like a texture stretched along one axis, with no readable ripple structure
issues.fix: raise the resolution of the reflection and normal maps at grazing angles and add anisotropic but structured wave detail

issues.where: the underwater fibres and cream patches in the foreground
issues.what: the orange fibres look like painted brush strokes laid on a flat plane with no parallax or refraction, and the cream patches are flat cutouts with sharp, uniformly bright edges; the surface above shows no reflection of sky over the clear water
issues.fix: model the mat as 3D strands under a refracting surface with caustics, add surface reflection with a fresnel falloff, and give the patches shape and soft edges

issues.where: the foreground pebbles across the shoreline
issues.what: the out-of-focus pebbles look like smooth clay lumps with posterised edges, and the blur looks like a painted smear rather than optical defocus; the repeated grey-cream pebble shapes look copied
issues.fix: vary pebble shape, size and material, and use proper depth-of-field bokeh on a detailed render

issues.where: the three adult animals and the young one
issues.what: the bodies are smooth model shapes with a uniform suede skin, and there is no wetness, mud or splash on legs that stand deep in water
issues.fix: add wet darkening and droplets on lower legs, splash and wake rings at the waterline, and skin variation such as dust, scars and hair

issues.where: above the horizon behind the animal (x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: a thin pale curved stroke and small specks float in the air above the water, like a stray artifact

issues.where: on the horizon (x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: a small pale object sits on the far water with no context
issues.fix: remove it or make it clearly part of the place

issues.where: the mist at the cliff base (x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: the haze is a flat uniform grey tint at the scree line with no light or structure
issues.fix: give the mist density variation and let the warm sun scatter into it
